config.trade_expansion.title: Trade Expansion Settings
config.trade_expansion.server_locked: Cannot be changed while connected to a server. Edit the server's config/trade_expansion.json and run /tradeex reload
config.trade_expansion.currency.ratios.0: How many copper coins one iron coin is worth. Decide it when creating the world (changing it changes the value of coins already held)
config.trade_expansion.currency.ratios.1: How many iron coins one gold coin is worth
config.trade_expansion.currency.ratios.2: How many gold coins one diamond coin is worth
config.trade_expansion.currency.ratios.3: How many diamond coins one netherite coin is worth
config.trade_expansion.currency.ratioLoc: When on, a world keeps the ratios it was created with even if the setting changes
config.trade_expansion.currency.allowMin: Recipes that turn copper / iron blocks into coins (not implemented yet)
config.trade_expansion.currency.exchange: Fee ratio of the exchange tab (not implemented yet)
config.trade_expansion.currency.starting: Money given on first login (c) (not implemented yet)
config.trade_expansion.currency.mobDropC: Hostile mobs killed by a player drop a few coins (not implemented yet)
config.trade_expansion.currency.sneakUse: Sneak + use breaks one coin into the next smaller coins
config.trade_expansion.currency.emeraldC: Coins the stonecutter makes from one emerald block. 0 disables the recipe. Applies after a restart or /reload
config.trade_expansion.price.defaultSpre: Gap between buy and sell prices (default when a good does not set it). Changes existing prices immediately
config.trade_expansion.price.defaultElas: Larger = prices move less per trade (default when a good does not set it)
config.trade_expansion.price.minMultipli: Prices never drop below this share of the base price
config.trade_expansion.price.maxMultipli: Prices never rise above this multiple of the base price
config.trade_expansion.price.jitter.desc: Random spread of base prices in new markets (existing markets keep theirs)
config.trade_expansion.price.defaultMaxS: Stock cap = target stock × this, when a good does not set it
config.trade_expansion.price.globalMulti: Multiplies every price. Changes existing prices immediately
config.trade_expansion.recovery.halfLife: In-game days until a price deviation is halved
config.trade_expansion.recovery.clock.de: GAME_TIME: sleeping does not count / DAY_TIME: sleeping counts. Switching may shift recovery once
config.trade_expansion.distance.mergeRad: Stalls within this distance share one market
config.trade_expansion.distance.nearRadi: Markets within this distance share price changes 100%
config.trade_expansion.distance.farRadiu: Markets farther than this are not affected
config.trade_expansion.distance.falloffE: 1 = linear, 2 = drops quickly just outside the near radius
config.trade_expansion.distance.linkNeth: Treat Nether coordinates × 8 as Overworld coordinates for price links (not implemented yet)
config.trade_expansion.distance.minNewMa: A crafted stall may found a new market only this far from existing markets
config.trade_expansion.market.levelThres: Beds around the market needed for level 2
config.trade_expansion.market.villagerTh: The Nether and the End measure villagers instead of beds
config.trade_expansion.market.levelRadiu: Beds / villagers within this horizontal distance are counted
config.trade_expansion.market.levelCheck: Opening the screen re-measures the level after this many in-game days
config.trade_expansion.wallet.autoCollec: Coins go into the wallet automatically while you carry one
config.trade_expansion.bank.minMarketLev: Markets of at least this level show the bank tab
config.trade_expansion.bank.interestRate: Interest rate per in-game day. 0 = none (not implemented yet)
config.trade_expansion.bank.cardFee.desc: Fee to issue or reissue a card (c)
config.trade_expansion.trade.maxDistance: You must be this close to the stall to trade
config.trade_expansion.trade.acceptDamag: Buy damaged items at a price reduced by durability (not implemented yet)
config.trade_expansion.trade.priceTolera: Cancel when the price moved more than this ratio from the preview. 0 = any change cancels
config.trade_expansion.trade.allowShiftA: Shift trades the largest possible quantity (not implemented yet)
config.trade_expansion.trade.allowCreati: Let creative-mode players trade (off by default: infinite items break the economy)
config.trade_expansion.worldgen.spawnSta: Place stalls in newly generated villages (not implemented yet)
config.trade_expansion.worldgen.protectN: Naturally generated stalls cannot be broken (not implemented yet)
config.trade_expansion.worldgen.spawnTra: Place a trader NPC in front of stalls (not implemented yet)
config.trade_expansion.log.trades.desc: Write every trade to the server log
config.trade_expansion.command.permissio: Permission needed for /tradeex admin subcommands (2 = op)
config.trade_expansion.vanilla.disableVi: Disable vanilla villager trading (not implemented yet)
config.trade_expansion.client.showDebugT: Show base price etc. in trade screen tooltips (not implemented yet)
tooltip.trade_expansion.wallet_hint: Stack coins onto it to store them. Use to take coins out
screen.trade_expansion.bank.issue_card: Issue a card (fee %s, from the account)
bank.trade_expansion.result.creative_not: The bank is not available in Creative mode
trade.trade_expansion.result.card_invali: You do not carry a valid card
